pay_detail: Unpaid. New volunteers pay a one-time $50 mission investment.
notes: The FAQ lists a junior option for ages 12 to 15. It needs an adult volunteer partner over 21. Email volunteer@columbushumane.org with questions.
name: Volunteer Program (teen volunteers ages 16 and 17)
what_you_do: Help care for shelter animals or help with non-animal tasks after training. Volunteers commit to at least 4 hours a month.
who_can_apply: Teens 16 and 17 can volunteer on their own. A guardian must sign a Junior and Teen Volunteer Waiver and Release. Junior volunteers ages 12 to 15 may volunteer with an adult volunteer partner over the age of 21.
deadline_text: No deadline posted. Sign up any time on the volunteer page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the New Volunteer Registration form. Then use the emailed link to book an in-person STEPS orientation in Hilliard. Next, finish species training and mentoring. Then start to book shifts. The page says the whole process takes about 6 to 8 hours.
